english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Five Releases: what they are
english_classification.chapter_note: Oldest teaching layer strongly dominant. Teaching purity 0.950, one of the highest in the corpus. The chapter is a systematic five-fold enumeration of cosmic 'releases' corresponding to the five wars of Ch.18. Near-zero editorial fatigue — the substrate character holds from beginning to end. Only two editorial interventions: the dialogue frame opening and the beatitude closure. One institutional insertion ('all the churches' in ¶6). The heavy lacunae, especially in ¶¶4, 8, 10-11, obscure the teaching but do not affect its character. The five-fold structure (First Man, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Splendour, Counsel of Life/Summons and Obedience) is a complete cosmic salvation sequence. The Phil. 2 parallel noted in footnotes concerns Jesus the Splendour's descent — the concept (cosmic figure descending through forms) is substrate; the Coptic translator's vocabulary may echo NT language.
